title: depletion — cupidity

sentences.sentence: Overfishing not only causes depletion in individual fish stocks, but also disruption to entire ecosystems and food webs in the ocean.
sentences.translation: 过度捕捞不仅引起个别鱼种的消耗，而且还引起海洋中整个生态系统和食物网的崩溃。

sentences.sentence: This decreases the device thickness and depletion voltage and consequently reduces material quality requirements and cost of the detector material.
sentences.translation: 这减少了设备的厚度和电压损耗，从而降低材料的质量要求和探测器的材料成本。

sentences.sentence: I also have a feather from another species making a comeback against the odds, the peregrine falcon.
sentences.translation: 我还有一支游隼羽毛，这是另一个被挽救的生物种类。

sentences.sentence: One of Scotland’s best ridge walks is a favourite of Nutkins: it offers a chance to see golden eagles, peregrine falcons and ravens, as well as glorious wild and mountainous countryside.
sentences.translation: 在这苏格兰山岭散步的最佳之地是努特金的爱好之一: 在这里，有机会看到金雕，游隼及乌鸦，还有美丽的大自然以及山区农村的风情。

sentences.sentence: Fringe benefits here include a cigar club, the fastest lifts in the world, and the chance to snap peregrine falcons as they migrate past your no doubt hermetically sealed expanse of window.
sentences.translation: 这里的额外好处包括了一个雪茄俱乐部，世界上最快速的电梯，以及当游隼迁徙飞过你的绝对密封的巨大玻璃窗户时，抓住它们的机会。

sentences.sentence: If the male foetus does not receive enough male hormone at the appropriate time, one of two things may happen.

sentences.sentence: Gays, Lesbians and TranssexualsResearch shows that the basic template for the body and brain of a human foetus is female in its structure.

sentences.sentence: He argued that the overcrowded cities were the product of a system based on "selfishness" and "rapacity."

sentences.sentence: For me, this value is to be sought on a much less elevated plane than might be supposed, namely, in that which is the true function of the organ of the eye, the eye filled with voracity, the evil eye.
sentences.translation: 对我而言，这个价值的寻找位置，应该是在我们以为不甚崇高的层面，换言之，应该是在眼睛这个器官的真实功用，充满贪婪的眼睛，邪恶之眼。

text:
英语词汇 · GRE · 第 245 单元

depletion
音标：英 /dɪ'pliːʃn/  美 /dɪ'pliʃən/
n. 损耗
短语：ozone depletion — 臭氧消耗；臭氧枯竭
短语：depletion region — [电]耗尽区；势垒区；阻挡层
例句：Overfishing not only causes depletion in individual fish stocks, but also disruption to entire ecosystems and food webs in the ocean.
过度捕捞不仅引起个别鱼种的消耗，而且还引起海洋中整个生态系统和食物网的崩溃。
例句：This decreases the device thickness and depletion voltage and consequently reduces material quality requirements and cost of the detector material.
这减少了设备的厚度和电压损耗，从而降低材料的质量要求和探测器的材料成本。

peregrine
n. 隼
例句：I also have a feather from another species making a comeback against the odds, the peregrine falcon.
我还有一支游隼羽毛，这是另一个被挽救的生物种类。
例句：One of Scotland’s best ridge walks is a favourite of Nutkins: it offers a chance to see golden eagles, peregrine falcons and ravens, as well as glorious wild and mountainous countryside.
在这苏格兰山岭散步的最佳之地是努特金的爱好之一: 在这里，有机会看到金雕，游隼及乌鸦，还有美丽的大自然以及山区农村的风情。
例句：Fringe benefits here include a cigar club, the fastest lifts in the world, and the chance to snap peregrine falcons as they migrate past your no doubt hermetically sealed expanse of window.
这里的额外好处包括了一个雪茄俱乐部，世界上最快速的电梯，以及当游隼迁徙飞过你的绝对密封的巨大玻璃窗户时，抓住它们的机会。

mortise
音标：英 /'mɔːtɪs/  美 /'mɔrtɪs/
n. 榫眼, 印刷版穴
短语：mortise lock — 插锁
短语：mortise and tenon — 阴阳榫
短语：tenon and mortise — 榫臼；雌雄准
短语：mortise joint — 镶榫接头

indent
音标：英 /ɪn'dent/  美 /ɪn'dɛnt/
n. 缩进, 契约, 订货单, 凹痕
短语：indent for — （英）订货；（英）申请供应

indentation
音标：英 /ɪnden'teɪʃ(ə)n/  美 /,ɪndɛn'teʃən/
n. 缩排, 呈锯齿状, 缺口, 印凹痕
短语：indentation test — 压痕试验
短语：indentation method — 刻痕法，压痕法
短语：indentation hardness — 压痕硬度
例句：Make an indentation in the center of each cookie.
在每块甜饼干的中间挖一个缺口。

miniature
音标：英 /'mɪnɪtʃə/  美 /ˈmɪniətʃɚ; ˈmɪnɪtʃɚ/
n. 缩小的模型, 缩图, 缩影
短语：in miniature — 小型；小规模
短语：miniature schnauzer — 迷你雪纳瑞
短语：miniature golf — 小型高尔夫游戏；小小高尔夫球
短语：miniature bearing — 微型轴承
短语：miniature circuit breaker — 小型断路器；微型电路继电器；保险丝壳；跳菲
短语：miniature camera — n. 小型照像机
例句：She’s her mother in miniature.
她是她母亲的缩影。

abbreviation
音标：英 /əbriːvɪ'eɪʃ(ə)n/  美 /əˌbrivɪ'eʃən/
n. 缩写, 缩写词
例句：The abbreviation for Kansas is KS.
的缩写是。

desideratum
音标：英 /dɪ,zɪdə'rɑːtəm; -'reɪtəm; -,sɪd-/  美 /dɪ'zɪdə'rɑtəm/
n. 所愿望之物, 迫切需要之物

rig
音标：英 /rɪg/  美 /rɪɡ/
n. 索具装备, 钻探设备, 钻探平台, 钻塔
短语：drilling rig — 钻机，钻探装置
短语：test rig — 试验台；试验装置，试验设备
短语：drill rig — 钻机；凿岩机
短语：oil rig — 石油钻塔，油井设备
短语：rotary drilling rig — 旋转钻机
短语：rig up — 装配；草草做成
例句：...a supply vessel for oil rigs in the Gulf of Mexico.
…一艘墨西哥湾石油钻塔的供给船。

trivia
音标：英 /'trɪvɪə/  美 /'trɪvɪə/
n. 琐事
例句：meaningless trivia
毫无意义的琐事

trifle
音标：英 /'traɪf(ə)l/  美 /'traɪfl/
n. 琐事, 少量, 蛋糕, 小事
短语：trifle with — 玩弄；视同儿戏；心不在焉地做
短语：mere trifle — 小意思
例句：There’s no point in arguing over trifles.
为琐事争吵毫无意义。

pylon
音标：英 /'paɪlən; 'paɪlɒn/  美 /'paɪlən/
n. 塔门, 路标塔

treadmill
音标：英 /'tredmɪl/  美 /'trɛdmɪl/
n. 踏车, 单调的工作
例句：the treadmill of working in the office
单调枯燥的办公室工作

foetus
音标：英 /'fiːtəs/  美 /'fitəs/
n. 胎儿
短语：foetus education — 胎教
例句：In this chapter we will look at what happens when a human foetus receives too much or too little male hormone.
在这一章里，我们将看看当一个人类胎儿接收了过多或过少的雄性激素会发生什么。
例句：If the male foetus does not receive enough male hormone at the appropriate time, one of two things may happen.
如果在适当的时间内，男性胎儿没有接收到足够的雄性激素，就会发生两件情况之一。
例句：Gays, Lesbians and TranssexualsResearch shows that the basic template for the body and brain of a human foetus is female in its structure.
对男同性恋、女同性恋和变性人的研究显示，人类胎儿的身体和大脑基础模板在结构上是女性。

fetus
音标：英 /'fiːtəs/  美 /'fitəs/
n. 胎儿
例句：Pregnant women who are heavy drinkers risk damaging the unborn fetus.
酗酒的孕妇冒有伤害胎儿的危险。

muscology
n. 苔藓植物学

avarice
音标：英 /'æv(ə)rɪs/  美 /'ævərɪs/
n. 贪财, 贪婪
例句：He paid a month's rent in advance, just enough to satisfy the landlord's avarice.
他预交了一个月的房租，正好满足了房东的贪心。

rapacity
音标：美 /rə'pæsəti/
n. 贪婪, 掠夺
例句：He argued that the overcrowded cities were the product of a system based on "selfishness" and "rapacity."
他辩称说，过分拥挤的城市是建立在“自私”和“贪婪”基础上的制度造成的。

voracity
n. 贪食, 贪婪
例句：For me, this value is to be sought on a much less elevated plane than might be supposed, namely, in that which is the true function of the organ of the eye, the eye filled with voracity, the evil eye.
对我而言，这个价值的寻找位置，应该是在我们以为不甚崇高的层面，换言之，应该是在眼睛这个器官的真实功用，充满贪婪的眼睛，邪恶之眼。

cupidity
音标：英 /kjuː'pɪdɪtɪ/  美 /kju'pɪdəti/
n. 贪心, 贪婪
例句：the cupidity of some businessmen
一些商人的贪婪
